title: Proposal Data
description: Schema for proposals/proposal-data.json, the input of assemble-preview.js --type proposal and validate-proposal.js. A proposal board is a row of authored Fat Marker screens with captions, for component-scale tickets.

meta.description: Board-level context printed in the header and the provenance comment

title.description: Board title, printed as the page H1 and the document title
examples: DIP-I-496: show role and permission for a logged-in user

ticket.description: Ticket or story id the proposal answers

date.description: Authoring date, YYYY-MM-DD, printed in the header. Never a render-time clock, so a re-render is byte-identical

apps.description: App slugs the board touches, printed in the header context line

items.description: An app slug the vendored app-context knows

prompt.description: The request the board answers, kept in the provenance comment only
examples: find a simple and elegant solution for showing a user's roles

model.description: Model that authored the board, provenance comment only

skill.description: Always design-proposal; lets a reader tell this file from a flow-data.json

recommendation.description: Optional HTML fragment rendered after the screens: which concept to ship and why
examples: Ship the badge, designed to grow into the My access panel.

screens.description: The screens on the board, left to right. One to eight; the validator enforces the upper bound

items.description: One authored screen: a Fat Marker fragment with a caption, rendered at its own width under an app header strip

id.description: Slug unique in the file; the screen's anchor and data-name

name.description: Short label printed above the screen with its number

app.description: App slug from the vendored app-context; the assembler renders that app's header strip and refuses an unknown slug

chrome.description: header renders the app header strip above the fragment; none renders the fragment alone

width.description: Screen width in px, 240 to 720 (validator-enforced); 360 suits a form region, 320 a menu, 720 a page region

caption.description: One sentence under the screen naming the decision it shows
examples: Single-group case: the badge is the whole answer, no extra click.

html.description: The Fat Marker fragment: fm-* classes and --fm-* tokens only, no script, no external loads; see references/design-proposal/board-authoring.md
